text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to decide which v1 routes stay behind parity flags vs full deprecation. Customer asks are stacking up (Enterprise X wants stable embeddings, Startup Y needs tool-calling compatibility).

Liam: my reading — prioritize: 1) embeddings, 2) chat/completions, 3) tool/function-calls, 4) structured output enforcement. embeddings are low-risk shim. tool-calls are the biggest compatibility landmine. :eyes:

Priya: For tool-calls the signature changed (named args + richer types). We can add a gateway adapter that transforms v1 payloads to v2 format for 6 months. That buys time for customers to migrate their tool manifests.

Carlos: Enterprise X will only migrate once we guarantee token parity + no rerank quality regression. They asked for migration docs and an example with their rerank eval set.

Ellie: I'll own migration docs + example apps. Proposal: one doc per route with a small code snippet, migration checklist, and a sample canary script.

Liam: draft gateway config snippet (for ops):
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/chat.completions",
  "compatibility": "gateway-adapter",
  "transform": "v1-to-v2-chat",
  "fallback": "/v2/chat.completions?compat=true",
  "telemetry": "dual-run"
}
```

Maya: Launch acceptance criteria suggestion:
- No client-facing schema changes without shim in place.
- Regression < 1.5% on critical evals (chat & embeddings) in canary window.
- Telemetry showing <0.5% error spike within first 72h for opt-in customers.
- Migration guide published and linked in Console.

Priya: additonally — automated post-migration quality checks for rerank/embeddings (sample prompts + threshold). We should surface these as guardrails in Redwood Console.

Liam: implementation tradeoffs: gateway adapter is fastest but adds another moving part in the path (latency + ops). Alternative is runtime polyfill inside the model-serving layer (less latency but riskier to roll out). Recommend gateway first, runtime polyfill later.

Carlos: timeline input from key customers — they need 60 days notice before final removal of any v1 route. Can we commit to 6 months dual-run support after GA?

Maya: proposal to negotiate: 6 months dual-run for embeddings & chat, 3 months for structured-output enforcement (keep a permissive mode), and explicit opt-in for tool-calls compatibility. Notify customers 60 days before final deprecation date.

Ellie: I'll draft the customer-facing timeline + sample email. Goal: publish migration guide + timeline next week for early adopters.

Liam: ops checklist for release (short):
- feature flag gate for each route
- gateway adapter rolled to staging
- canary traffic at 1% for 48h
- run regression suite (chat + embeddings + tool-calls)
- open rollback policy + playbook (ops will validate)

deploy-bot: deploy started: gateway-adapter/v1-shim -> staging (id: adp-2026-42)

Priya: open question — structured output schemas: do we enforce strict JSON schema at GA or soft-validate with warnings? My preference: soft-validate, warnings in Console, strict mode behind tenant flag.

Maya: agreed on soft-validate at GA. Strict enforcement behind tenant flag for 1.0.

Carlos: customers will appreciate a compatibility matrix table (route x gap x mitigations). Ellie — please include that.

Ellie: noted. I'll include matrix + migration code samples and a short checklist for SRE to run during cutover.

Maya: decisions captured:
- Gateway adapter shim for tool-calls & chat compatibility as near-term approach.
- 6 months dual-run for embeddings & chat, 3 months permissive for structured output.
- 60-day notice before final deprecation.
- Migration guide + example apps to be published next week.

Action items:
- Ellie: migration guide + customer timeline (due EOD Thu).
- Liam: roll gateway adapter to canary + ops playbook (due Wed).
- Priya: build rerank/embedding regression harness + thresholds (due Fri).
- Maya: draft public deprecation policy & notice language (due Thu).

Maya: anything else? If not, we'll lock this plan and spin up the doc PR. :thumbsup:

Liam: :thumbsup: locking plan unless someone has blocking concerns.

Carlos: no blockers from CS side — will prep customer outreach once doc is ready.

Ellie: starting the doc now.

Priya: will post the regression harness link here when ready.

Maya: thanks everyone — closing the thread once PR is opened.
